title: Selection Bounds For Diagram And Scene
description: Add matching transparent axis-aligned selection bounds: SVG rect in SemioDiagram, 3D box in SemioScene, shared opacity/accent styling.
summary: Added shared selection overlay styling (SEMIO_SELECTION_BOUNDS_FILL_OPACITY / STROKE_OPACITY on var(--accent)). SemioDiagram draws an SVG rect under edges/nodes from selected pieces and connections. SemioScene builds an axis-aligned Box3 from piece world anchors and connection endpoints, renders SceneSelectionBounds (transparent box + Edges) behind scene content. Extended vitests for computeDiagramSelectionOverlayRect and buildSceneSelectionBoundsBox. All semio/ui vitest tests pass.
